label: If x depends for its being on y, y does not depend for its being on x
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise: if x depends for its being on y, y does not depend for its being on x (hence nothing depends on itself). Mutual counterfactual dependence would falsify it. It therefore presupposes a strict, non-reflexive reading of DependsForBeing: if everything depends for its being on itself, as the literal counterfactual reading gives, it fails on any domain with one being (#1593). Its distinct-pair part is STMT-DISTINCT-BEINGS-NOT-MUTUALLY-DEPENDENT.
